title: DROP FUNCTION
description: Learn how to remove user-defined functions using the DROP FUNCTION statement.

data.text: To remove an existing user-defined function, use the DROP FUNCTION statement. The IF EXISTS option prevents errors when dropping a function that may not exist.

data.title: DROP FUNCTION basic syntax
data.content: Drops a function safely if it exists.

data.text: If the function is referenced by views or other functions created WITH SCHEMABINDING, or by CHECK/DEFAULT constraints and computed columns, DROP FUNCTION will fail. You must drop the dependent objects first.

data.title: Drop dependent view first, then function
data.content: Drops a view that references a function, then drops the function.
data.code:
DROP VIEW sales.discounts;

DROP FUNCTION sales.udf_get_discount_amount;

data.title: Drop multiple functions at once
data.content: Removes multiple functions in a single statement.

data.title: DROP FUNCTION Key Points
points: Use DROP FUNCTION to remove user-defined functions.
Always use IF EXISTS to avoid errors on non-existent functions.
DROP FUNCTION fails if the function is referenced by dependent objects.
You can drop multiple functions in a single statement.
